## YouTube Community

Update: The Fed held on October 28. Both dissenters wanted a hike.

The Fed's October 28 hold was a 10-2 decision. Both dissenters wanted higher rates.

What to watch: The next useful question is whether a later Committee decision changes the target range or the direction of the recorded vote. The October 28 documents should be read as that meeting's decision and implementation instructions, rather than a prediction of what comes next.
